origin.historyZh: 幼羊绒的第一次梳绒——稀有、细腻、极为柔软。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: The first combing of young cashmere goats — rare, fine, and exceptionally soft.
story.bodyZh: 幼羊绒的第一次梳绒——稀有、细腻、极为柔软。

baby-cashmere.scientificNameZh: 山羊 Capra hircus laniger（底层绒）

originLine.zh: 内亚牧区 · 意大利整理（公开叙述）

thesis.en: Next to skin, baby cashmere is warmth without the prickle of ordinary sheep wool.
thesis.zh: 贴身时，baby cashmere 是没有普通绵羊毛刺痒的暖。

vsOrdinary.en: Ordinary sheep wool is coarser. Baby cashmere language tracks lower micron and first combing — the body reads diameter before it reads a brand.
vsOrdinary.zh: 普通绵羊毛更粗。Baby cashmere 语言追踪更低微米与第一次梳绒——身体先读直径，再读品牌。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Soft undercoat hand; low prickle risk when micron is true.
senses.bodyZh: 底层绒手感；微米属实时刺痒风险低。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: Light insulation for long hours indoors.
senses.bodyZh: 长时间室内的轻保暖。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Pilling management is part of ownership.
senses.bodyZh: 管理起球是拥有的一部分。

whyExists.en: Kept because undercoat diameter delivers next-to-skin comfort that coarser fibres cannot fake without changing the animal itself.
whyExists.zh: 留下它，是因为底层绒直径带来的贴身舒适，粗纤维无法在不改变动物本身的前提下伪造。

evidence.label: Diameter language
evidence.note: Public comfort literature links mean diameter to prickle.
evidence.noteZh: 公开舒适性研究将平均直径与刺痒感关联。

evidence.label: Yield per animal
evidence.note: First combing volumes are intrinsically limited.
evidence.noteZh: 第一次梳绒量本身有限。

evidence.label: Dehairing loss
evidence.note: Guard hair removal reduces usable undercoat.
evidence.noteZh: 去除粗毛减少可用底绒。

thesis.en: Price tracks micron, first-combing yield, and dehairing loss.
thesis.zh: 价格跟随微米、第一次梳绒产量与除粗损耗。

factors.label: Yield cap
factors.figure: First combing is small by biology
factors.figureZh: 第一次梳绒量由生物决定

factors.label: Dehairing labour

factors.label: Season
factors.figureZh: 收获受气候与福利约束

factors.label: Grading loss

factors.figureZh: 偏离微米的批次离开顶档

journey.title: Finishing

journey.title: Object

journey.bodyZh: 纱线成为可持存的针织。

cultural.en: Pastoral societies priced warmth by weight carried on the body. Micron language is the modern form of that constraint.
cultural.zh: 游牧社会按随身重量为保暖计价。微米语言是这一约束的现代表达。

hero.en: Difference is something the body notices first.
hero.zh: 差别，是身体先察觉到的事。

thesis.en: Linen cools the body with a dry, open hand ordinary cotton rarely matches in heat.
thesis.zh: 亚麻以干燥、开放的触感降温，暑热中普通棉少有同款。

vsOrdinary.en: Cotton stays softer but holds damp longer. Linen’s bast structure moves air and dries with a crisp hand.
vsOrdinary.zh: 棉更软，但潮气停留更久。亚麻韧皮结构更透气，干后触感爽利。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Dry crispness that softens with wear.
senses.bodyZh: 干爽，穿用后渐软。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: Heat escapes; wrinkles are part of the surface.
senses.bodyZh: 暑热散出；褶皱即表面。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Strength stays high when damp relative to many soft cloths.
senses.bodyZh: 潮湿时相对许多软布仍有强力。

whyExists.en: Flax grown and woven with cool hand and lasting drape.
whyExists.zh: 凉爽手感与持久垂坠的亚麻织造。

thesis.en: Cost follows place, time, labour, and reject rate.
thesis.zh: 成本跟随产地、时间、人工与废品率。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: Extra-long staple cotton prized for silk-like luster.
story.bodyZh: 超长绒棉，以丝绸般光泽著称。

hero.en: Length is what the skin reads as silk-without-silk.
hero.zh: 长度，是皮肤读成「无丝之丝」的原因。

thesis.en: Against skin, extra-long staple cotton feels smoother and less fuzzy than ordinary upland cotton.
thesis.zh: 贴身时，超长绒棉比普通陆地棉更滑、更少浮毛感。

vsOrdinary.en: Ordinary upland cotton (G. hirsutum) is shorter staple — yarns show more hairiness. Sea Island / ELS barbadense staple length supports finer, more lustrous yarns.
vsOrdinary.zh: 普通陆地棉（G. hirsutum）绒更短——纱线更易起毛。海岛/长绒棉的超长绒支持更细、更有光泽的纱。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Silk-like slip from staple length, not from protein fibre.
senses.bodyZh: 来自绒长的丝滑，而非蛋白纤维。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: Fine yarns reduce itch from protruding ends.
senses.bodyZh: 细纱减少纤维头刺痒。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Higher strength grades keep hand longer if cared for.
senses.bodyZh: 高强力等级在护理下更耐久。

whyExists.en: Kept because G. barbadense delivers extra-long staple and fineness that upland cotton yield systems rarely match.
whyExists.zh: 留下它，是因为海岛棉提供陆地棉高产体系难以同时达到的超长绒与细度。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: One of the rarest animal fibers — reserved for exceptional pieces.
story.bodyZh: 最稀有的动物纤维之一——仅用于非凡之作。

thesis.en: On skin, vicuña is lighter warmth than ordinary sheep wool — fineness you feel as absence of prickle.
thesis.zh: 贴身时，驼马绒是比普通绵羊毛更轻的暖——细度表现为没有刺痒。

vsOrdinary.en: Ordinary sheep wool is coarser (often ~20+ μm). Vicuña down is publicly reported around 12–14 μm, with roughly 200–250 g raw fibre per animal and shearing often every two years.
vsOrdinary.zh: 普通绵羊毛更粗（常约 20+ μm）。公开报道驼马底层绒约 12–14 μm，单只原绒约 200–250 g，常两年一剪。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Next-to-skin softness from micron scale.
senses.bodyZh: 微米尺度带来的贴身柔软。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: High insulation at low mass.
senses.bodyZh: 低质量下的高保暖。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Needs careful abrasion management.
senses.bodyZh: 需谨慎管理磨损。

whyExists.en: Kept because Andean altitude biology produces a legal fibre finer than most sheep wools — and yield per animal stays tiny.
whyExists.zh: 留下它，是因为安第斯海拔生物学产出比多数绵羊毛更细的合法纤维——且单只产量极低。

mulberry-silk-taihu.name: Mulberry Silk (Taihu)

craft.title: Mulberry & silkworm
craft.body: Leaf selection, temperature, stillness. Only in the right humidity do silkworms spin an even filament.
craft.bodyZh: 择叶、控温、静养。蚕只在适宜的湿度与安静中吐出匀细的丝。

craft.title: Cocoon & reeling
craft.body: Harvest at the right hour; warm water loosens ends; filaments join into raw silk. Timing governs sheen and strength.
craft.bodyZh: 适时采茧，温水索绪，多绪合并成生丝。时机决定光泽与韧性。

craft.title: Degumming & finish
craft.body: Degumming clears impurities while keeping the fiber’s breath — never a factory gloss laid on top.
craft.bodyZh: 脱胶去杂，保留纤维本身的呼吸感，而非覆盖一层工业光亮。

craft.title: Weaving
craft.body: Warp and weft meet at a patient pace. The cloth records small differences of place and season.
craft.bodyZh: 经纬相交，慢工成型。布面记录着产地与季节的细微差别。

origin.history: Since antiquity, Taihu silk has been central to tribute and weaving traditions.
origin.historyZh: 自先秦以来，太湖丝便是贡赋与织造的重要原料。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: Warm humidity and generous mulberry leaves allow cocoons to form slowly. The near-triangular fiber cross-section catches light in a characteristic sheen — lake silk’s fine, even, soft character belongs to this water and air.
story.bodyZh: 太湖流域温暖湿润，桑叶肥厚，蚕茧得以缓慢结成。纤维截面近乎三角，折射出特有的光泽。只有在这样的水与气之间，湖丝才呈现出细、匀、柔的品质。

mulberry-silk-taihu.scientificNameZh: 家蚕 Bombyx mori（丝素长丝）

hero.en: Value does not fade with the season that made it.
hero.zh: 真正的材料，不会随制造它的季节一同消逝。

thesis.en: On skin, mulberry silk is cool slip and quiet weight — ordinary polyester is sealed heat.
thesis.zh: 贴身时，桑蚕丝是清凉的滑与安静的重量——普通涤纶是封闭的热。

vsOrdinary.en: Ordinary synthetics trap vapour against the body. Silk filament moves moisture and light differently because it is a continuous protein filament, not a melt-spun plastic.
vsOrdinary.zh: 普通合成纤维把水汽闷在皮肤上。蚕丝长丝以连续蛋白丝移动湿气与光线——不是熔纺塑料。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Smooth filament; temperature reads cool at first contact.
senses.bodyZh: 长丝光滑；第一触偏凉。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: Drape follows the body without plastic spring-back.
senses.bodyZh: 垂感贴体，无塑料回弹。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Abrasion and sun are the real enemies — care is part of the experience.
senses.bodyZh: 磨损与日照是真正敌人——护理即体验的一部分。

whyExists.en: Humans kept silk because a fine continuous filament from a living cycle is hard to replace: strength at low mass, dye affinity, and a hand that synthetics still imitate rather than equal in public fibre science.
whyExists.zh: 人类留下它，是因为生物周期吐出的连续细丝难以替代：低质量下的强力、上色能力，以及合成纤维在公开纤维科学中仍在模仿的手感。

thesis.zh: 成本升高之处，是生物、季节与人手拒绝被压缩的地方。

journey.title: Finishing

journey.bodyZh: 脱胶而不封死呼吸。

origin.climate: Cold highland, strong sun, wide day–night swings
origin.climateZh: 高寒、日照强、昼夜温差大
origin.history: Pastoral peoples have long spun yak wool for warmth; fiber knowledge grew with highland life.
origin.historyZh: 游牧民族长期以牦牛绒御寒与织造，纤维知识与高原生活同生。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: As altitude rises and cold deepens, yaks grow finer underwool. The fiber is a biological answer to extremes — not a pastoral slogan.
story.bodyZh: 海拔升高，气温下降，牦牛生出更细密的底层绒以御寒。这种纤维不是牧场广告的产物，而是对极端气候的生物学回应。

hero.en: Cold is met with air trapped in the fibre — not with bulk.
hero.zh: 寒冷被纤维里的空气迎接——不是被厚度堆砌。

thesis.en: Worn, yak down feels warm like cashmere territory, often with a springier, less delicate surface.
thesis.zh: 穿着时，牦牛绒落在羊绒温度区，表面常更有弹性、不那么娇。

vsOrdinary.en: Ordinary sheep wool is coarser and pricklier for many wearers. Yak down is publicly discussed around mid-teens μm with hollow/crimped insulation behaviour; peer knit studies compare its handle to wool and cashmere.
vsOrdinary.zh: 普通绵羊毛对许多穿着者更粗、更刺。公开讨论中牦牛底层绒约十余 μm，具中空/卷曲保暖结构；同行针织研究将其手感与羊毛、羊绒对照。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Soft down hand; less status sheen than cashmere storytelling.
senses.bodyZh: 底层绒柔软；不如羊绒叙事那般「身份光泽」。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: Insulation with active moisture movement in cold use.
senses.bodyZh: 寒冷使用中保暖并带动湿气。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Often described as resisting pills better than fine cashmere knits.
senses.bodyZh: 常被描述为比细羊绒针织更耐起球。

whyExists.en: Kept because high-altitude cattle grow a down that insulates at low mass where sheep wool feels heavy.
whyExists.zh: 留下它，是因为高海拔牛只长出低质量保暖的底层绒——绵羊毛在此显得沉重。

origin.history: Bast fiber for Xia Bu summer cloth — cool hand, crisp structure, and lasting breathability.
origin.historyZh: 夏布原料苎麻——凉爽挺括、透气持久。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: Bast fiber for Xia Bu summer cloth — cool hand, crisp structure, and lasting breathability.
story.bodyZh: 夏布原料苎麻——凉爽挺括、透气持久。

hero.en: Cool air moves through the cloth before heat builds on skin.
hero.zh: 热意在皮肤堆积之前，凉气先穿过布面。

thesis.en: On skin, ramie reads as crisp coolness that dries faster than ordinary cotton.
thesis.zh: 贴身时，苎麻是比普通棉更快干爽的清凉触感。

vsOrdinary.en: Ordinary cotton softens by swelling with moisture and stays damp longer. Ramie absorbs quickly, swells less, and releases vapour faster — so humid days feel less sticky.
vsOrdinary.zh: 普通棉靠吸湿膨胀变软，也更久潮湿。苎麻吸得快、胀得少、散得快——潮湿天气更不黏。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Crisp hand; less cloudy softness than cotton.
senses.bodyZh: 触感偏爽利，不如棉那样蓬软。

senses.label: Wear
senses.body: Airflow and fast dry-down in heat.
senses.bodyZh: 暑热中透气，干得更快。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Holds shape; wet strength stays relatively high.
senses.bodyZh: 更易保持形态；湿态强力相对更高。

whyExists.en: Kept because bast cellulose delivers high tensile strength and quick moisture release in heat — hard to fake with short-staple cotton alone.
whyExists.zh: 留下它，是因为韧皮纤维素在暑热中提供高强力与快速排湿——单靠短绒棉难以替代。

origin.climate: Warm and humid — favors laccase curing
origin.climateZh: 温暖湿润，利于漆酶反应
origin.history: China’s lacquer tradition spans millennia, bound to ritual objects and vessel culture.
origin.historyZh: 中国使用大漆的历史可追溯数千年，漆器文明与礼仪器物紧密相连。

story.title: A gift of nature
story.body: Lacquer trees need the right hills and time. Tapping is seasonal; yield is finite. Each drop marks the rhythm of tree and year.
story.bodyZh: 漆树需要适宜的山地气候与时间。割漆有季节，产量有限。每一滴生漆都标记着树木与年份的节奏。

hero.en: Each coat is a day you cannot rush.
hero.zh: 每一层，都是无法催促的一天。

thesis.en: Under the finger, urushi is depth you fall into — ordinary PU is a sealed skin that never breathes time.
thesis.zh: 指下，大漆是可坠入的深度——普通聚氨酯是永不呼吸时间的封闭皮。

vsOrdinary.en: Spray coatings finish in hours. Lacquer finishes in coats and humid days — the hand learns patience as shine.
vsOrdinary.zh: 喷涂数小时完成。大漆以层数与阴干日完成——手把耐心认成光泽。

senses.label: Touch
senses.body: Warm depth, not plastic slick.
senses.bodyZh: 温润深度，非塑料滑。

senses.label: Use
senses.body: Object use polishes high planes.
senses.bodyZh: 把玩打磨高点。

senses.label: Over time
senses.body: Centuries are a documented museum possibility.
senses.bodyZh: 数百年是有博物馆证据的可能。

whyExists.en: Kept because a humidity-cured film can outlast the object’s century when coats are honest — a finish counted in calendar time, not spray passes.
whyExists.zh: 留下它，是因为诚实的阴干漆膜可以活过器物的世纪——以日历计量，而非喷涂次数。

identity.label: Main regions

evidence.label: Cure climate
evidence.note: Polymerisation depends on humidity rooms / furo.

evidence.label: Museum lifespan
evidence.note: Conservation literature documents long-lived lacquer objects.
evidence.noteZh: 保护文献记载长寿漆器。

thesis.en: The invoice is coats × curing days × failed layers.
thesis.zh: 账单是：层数 × 阴干天数 × 失败层。

journey.title: Refining
journey.body: Grade the sap for the coat.
journey.bodyZh: 按层选汁。

journey.title: Coating
journey.body: One thin film at a time.
journey.bodyZh: 一次一层薄膜。

journey.title: Curing
journey.body: Humidity finishes the chemistry.
journey.bodyZh: 湿度完成化学。

journey.title: Polishing
journey.body: Surface is read by hand.
journey.bodyZh: 手读表面。

journey.title: Aging
journey.body: Film hardens into memory.
journey.bodyZh: 漆膜沉为记忆。

journey.title: Object
journey.body: Wood becomes a lasting skin.
journey.bodyZh: 木成为可持存的皮。

cultural.zh: 文明选择它，是因为器物需要在潮湿与世纪中，以连续的表皮活下去。
